title: Re-integratietraject
description: The re-integration trajectory case type (Participatiewet): statuses, roles, results, its fields and a published flow. Handled by the dossiq-sociaal-domein group, confidential. Installed on every instance, as the re-integration list was. Its record import moves every stored reIntegratieTraject onto a case of this type on upgrade (RunUpgradeRecordImports), stamping the source with migratedTo and migratedAt.
